name: Auto Ontology v1 Semantic Layer for AI Agents
description: Semantic layer and NL-to-SQL for AI agents: MCP server, API and web UI.

upstream.version: 1.1.0 (images built from branch release/v1.1.0 at d14214e930fcb5988178ad51bde7672e600827a7; main checked at 6c4fb71e20c1f9fc4b6059aa1c99f55b697d60b0)

Frontend.preDeployCommand: /bin/sh -c 'cd /app/migrate || exit 1; i=1; until sh prisma/migrate.sh; do if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then echo "[railway] prisma schema sync failed 60 times, giving up" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[railway] prisma schema sync attempt $i failed (Postgres still starting?), retrying in 10 s" >&2; i=$((i+1)); sleep 10; done'

PORT.description: Port the Next.js server listens on (public domain target, healthcheck).

HOSTNAME.description: Bind address of the Next.js server.

APP_VERSION.description: Version shown in the UI footer and logs.

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Postgres private host (pgvector database for the catalog, auth tables and embeddings).

POSTGRES_DATABASE.description: Database holding the public (Alembic), frontend (Prisma) and vdb (pgvector) schemas.

PYTHON_API_URL.description: Backend API on the private network (read at runtime by the route handlers).

APP_URL.description: Public origin of the web app, required by Better Auth (sessions, CSRF, OAuth issuer, SSO callback). Change it when you add a custom domain.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Better Auth signing secret, generated at deploy. Changing it signs everyone out.

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login email of the bootstrap admin, created (or reset) on every start. Change it to yours.

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the bootstrap admin, generated at deploy and re-applied on every start (change it here and redeploy to rotate).

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public origin of the MCP server (without /mcp); OAuth tokens for MCP clients are bound to it. The MCP Server service references this value.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy.

Backend.preDeployCommand: /bin/sh -c 'cd /app || exit 1; i=1; until /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh migrate; do if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then echo "[railway] alembic upgrade failed 60 times, giving up" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[railway] alembic upgrade attempt $i failed (Postgres still starting?), retrying in 10 s" >&2; i=$((i+1)); sleep 10; done'

PORT.description: Port Railway health-checks (the API server always listens on 0.0.0.0:3001). Never add a public domain: this service trusts the x-auto-ontology-user-id header from the Frontend.

APP_VERSION.description: Version shown in logs (matches the pinned image).

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Postgres private host (pgvector database for the catalog, auth tables and embeddings).

POSTGRES_DATABASE.description: Database holding the public (Alembic), frontend (Prisma) and vdb (pgvector) schemas.

INGESTION_SERVICE_URL.description: Ingestion service on the private network (ingest and semantic compilation triggers).

DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY.description: Required. NVIDIA API key (nvapi-...), free from build.nvidia.com; used by every model below unless REASONING_API_KEY, NON_REASONING_API_KEY, EMBED_API_KEY or RERANK_API_KEY is set. Hosted endpoints are governed by NVIDIA's API trial terms.

DEFAULT_MODELS_ENDPOINT.description: Shared default endpoint (OpenAI-compatible) for any model field left unset.

DEFAULT_MODELS_MODEL.description: Shared default model for any model field left unset (upstream default).

REASONING_ENDPOINT.description: Main chat / NL-to-SQL model endpoint. Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint works; set REASONING_API_KEY for another provider.

NON_REASONING_ENDPOINT.description: Lighter model endpoint (entity extraction). OpenAI-compatible; set NON_REASONING_API_KEY for another provider.

EMBED_ENDPOINT.description: Embedding endpoint (NVIDIA NIM API). Ingest and query must use the same model; changing it needs a re-ingest.

EMBED_MODEL.description: Embedding model (upstream default; the vector table is created for 2048 dimensions).

CONNECTION_STRINGS.description: Optional. Comma-separated source database URLs (postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db, snowflake://..., ...). When set, connections come only from here and the Connections settings page is hidden. Leave empty to manage connections in the UI.

LLM_MAX_INFLIGHT.description: Max concurrent model requests per process (0 = unbounded). 6 stays under the hosted endpoint's per-key concurrency; lower it if you see HTTP 429/503.

LLM_INVOKE_TIMEOUT_S.description: Timeout per model call, in seconds.

OMP_NUM_THREADS.description: Caps native thread pools (numpy, onnxruntime) to the service's CPU share instead of the host's core count.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy (lets running chat turns finish).

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_IMAGE.description: Base image for this service's Docker build (Railway passes it as a build argument). Must match the Backend service's image.

INGESTION_PORT.description: Port the ingestion service listens on (0.0.0.0, private network only).

APP_VERSION.description: Version shown in logs (matches the pinned image).

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Postgres private host (pgvector database for the catalog, auth tables and embeddings).

POSTGRES_DATABASE.description: Database holding the public (Alembic), frontend (Prisma) and vdb (pgvector) schemas.

DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY.description: Same as DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY on Backend (change it there).

DEFAULT_MODELS_ENDPOINT.description: Same as DEFAULT_MODELS_ENDPOINT on Backend (change it there).

DEFAULT_MODELS_MODEL.description: Same as DEFAULT_MODELS_MODEL on Backend (change it there).

REASONING_ENDPOINT.description: Same as REASONING_ENDPOINT on Backend (change it there).

REASONING_MODEL.description: Same as REASONING_MODEL on Backend (change it there).

NON_REASONING_ENDPOINT.description: Same as NON_REASONING_ENDPOINT on Backend (change it there).

NON_REASONING_MODEL.description: Same as NON_REASONING_MODEL on Backend (change it there).

EMBED_ENDPOINT.description: Same as EMBED_ENDPOINT on Backend (change it there).

EMBED_MODEL.description: Same as EMBED_MODEL on Backend (change it there).

RERANK_ENDPOINT.description: Same as RERANK_ENDPOINT on Backend (change it there).

RERANK_MODEL.description: Same as RERANK_MODEL on Backend (change it there).

CONNECTION_STRINGS.description: Same as CONNECTION_STRINGS on Backend (change it there).

SEMANTIC_LLM_MAX_INFLIGHT.description: Concurrent model calls during semantic compilation (upstream default 6). Lower it on rate-limited keys.

PII_LLM_MAX_WORKERS.description: Concurrent model calls for PII classification, when enabled in Settings (upstream default 6).

OMP_NUM_THREADS.description: Caps native thread pools (numpy, onnxruntime) to the service's CPU share instead of the host's core count.

TEMPLATE_SAMPLE_CONNECTION.description: On the first boot of a fresh catalog, register the Chinook database on Sample Data as a normal connection (removable in Settings -> Connections). Runs once; false skips it.

TEMPLATE_ENABLE_SEMANTIC_COMPILATION.description: On the first boot, switch Settings -> Semantic Compilation on (only if never set), so questions work without manual steps. It re-runs every 24 h over every connected database and uses model calls; turn it off in the UI anytime.

TEMPLATE_SAMPLE_DB_USER.description: Read-only login for the sample database.

TEMPLATE_STARTUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: Max seconds the start wrapper waits for the Backend migration (and the first-boot steps) before giving up; keep it below the healthcheck timeout.

TEMPLATE_SAMPLE_WAIT_SECONDS.description: Max seconds the first boot waits for Sample Data to accept connections.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy (schedulers stop cleanly).

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_HOST.description: Bind address of the MCP server.

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_PORT.description: Port of the MCP server (public domain target).

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_API_URL.description: Public Auto Ontology web app: the OAuth authorization server MCP clients sign in with, and the API every tool call goes through as the signed-in user.

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: This server's public origin (set on Frontend, so both always agree).

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_TIMEOUT_S.description: Timeout for catalog and glossary API calls, in seconds.

AUTO_ONTOLOGY_MCP_CHAT_TIMEOUT_S.description: Timeout for one ask_question run (many model calls), in seconds.

Postgres.startCommand: /usr/bin/tini -g -- /bin/bash -c 'set -e; D="${PGDATA%/}"; F="$D/pgvector-tuning.conf"; C="$D/postgresql.conf"; I=/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d; X=/tmp/pgvector-tuning.conf; echo "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;" > $I/zz-pgvector-extensions.sql; k() { v=$1; if [ $v -lt $2 ]; then v=$2; fi; if [ $v -gt $3 ]; then v=$3; fi; echo $v; }; n() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo $2 ;; *) echo $1 ;; esac; }; w() { echo "$1 = $2" >> $X; }; if [ "${PGVECTOR_TUNING:-auto}" = off ]; then rm -f $F $I/zz-pgvector-conf.sh; echo "pgvector-tune: PGVECTOR_TUNING=off, Postgres defaults apply"; else H=$(( $(n "$(grep -m 1 MemTotal /proc/meminfo | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 2)" 1048576) / 1024 )); M=$(( $(n "$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null)" $((H * 1048576))) / 1048576 )); if [ $M -gt $H ]; then M=$H; fi; B=$(k $(n "$PG_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB" $(k $M 256 8192)) 256 4194304); N=$(nproc); read -r Q P 2>/dev/null < /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max || Q=max; case "$Q" in ""|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) N=$(k $(( (Q + P - 1) / P )) 1 $N) ;; esac; N=$(k $(n "$PG_CPU_LIMIT" $(k $N 1 8)) 1 256); S=$(( $(n "$(df -Pk /dev/shm 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 2)" 65536) / 1024 )); SB=$(k $((B / 4)) 128 1048576); MW=$(k $((B / 4)) 64 2048); PM=$(k $((N - 1)) 0 4); PW=$(k $N 2 256); PG=$(k $((N / 2)) 0 2); FIT=$((S * 3 / 4)); if [ $FIT -lt 128 ]; then PM=0; fi; if [ $PM -gt 0 ]; then MW=$(k $MW 64 $FIT); fi; if [ $S -lt 256 ]; then PG=0; fi; echo "# pgvector template: rewritten at every boot from budget ${B}MB (container ${M}MB), ${N} cpus, /dev/shm ${S}MB; ALTER SYSTEM overrides it" > $X; w shared_buffers ${SB}MB; w effective_cache_size $((B * 3 / 4))MB; w maintenance_work_mem ${MW}MB; w autovacuum_work_mem $(k $((B / 16)) 64 $MW)MB; w work_mem $(k $((B / 512)) 4 64)MB; w max_worker_processes $(k $((PW + 4)) 8 512); w max_parallel_workers $PW; w max_parallel_workers_per_gather $PG; w max_parallel_maintenance_workers $PM; w random_page_cost 1.1; w effective_io_concurrency 200; w track_io_timing on; chmod 644 $X; if [ -f $D/PG_VERSION ] && [ -f $C ]; then install -o postgres -g postgres -m 600 $X $F; grep -qsF "include_if_exists = pgvector-tuning.conf" $C || echo "include_if_exists = pgvector-tuning.conf" >> $C; sync $F $C 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "cp $X $F && chmod 600 $F && { grep -qsF pgvector-tuning.conf $C || echo include_if_exists = pgvector-tuning.conf >> $C; }" > $I/zz-pgvector-conf.sh; fi; echo "pgvector-tune: $(paste -sd " " $X)"; fi; exec /usr/local/bin/wrapper.sh "$@"' pgvector-start postgres -p 5432 -c listen_addresses=*

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume (Railway base layout; the image refuses anything outside /var/lib/postgresql/data).

PGHOST.description: Private hostname of this database (postgres.railway.internal), used by the Data panel and the other services.

PGUSER.description: User for the Data panel and the other services.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Data panel and the other services.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Data panel and the other services.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (letters only: the app builds URLs from it without escaping). Changing it later needs ALTER USER too.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot; the vector and pg_stat_statements extensions are created in it.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.

RAILWAY_SHM_SIZE_BYTES.description: Size of /dev/shm (1 GiB; Railway default 64 MB) for parallel HNSW index builds and parallel queries; only memory in use is billed.

PGVECTOR_TUNING.description: auto = size memory and parallelism from the container limits at every boot; off = Postgres defaults.

PG_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: RAM the tuning plans for. auto = the container limit capped at 8192 MB.

PG_CPU_LIMIT.description: CPUs the tuning plans for. auto = the container CPU quota capped at 8.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume (Railway base layout).

PGDATABASE.description: Database the Data panel and Auto Ontology open (the Chinook sample).

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot and filled with the Chinook sample (do not change after the first deploy).

SAMPLE_DB_READER_USER.description: Read-only login created on first boot for Auto Ontology (SELECT on Chinook only).

SAMPLE_DB_READER_PASSWORD.description: Password of that login, generated at deploy; applied on first boot only.

SAMPLE_DB_READER_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT.description: statement_timeout of the read-only login (protects the demo from runaway SQL).

SAMPLE_DATABASE_URL.description: Read-only connection string for the sample (private network).

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.
